source.document: Kubernetes v1.37 release retrospective (public Google Doc)
source.note: One topic from the public retrospective. Names masked as [participant]. Independent case written by cursor-agent. The extractor was not run.

notes:
* [participant] We had a Docs PR that appears to have merged without the required labels. GitHub logs suggest it was an indirect merge. Should we update the placeholder guidance in the handbook? While we are there, maybe we can also improve the guidance around PR titles and descriptions.
   * [participant] thread: https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C1J0BPD2M/p1785242855168749
   * [participant] Not possible to prevent this; potentially worthwhile to document what it looks like so we know what it is instead of causing panic
   * [participant] Should we discourage the empty commit placeholders?
   * [participant] No, the empty commit is required and skipping that is part of what caused this
